name: rake_records_tournament_large_evidence_keys
definition: CREATE INDEX rake_records_tournament_large_evidence_keys ON public.rake_records USING btree (tournament_id, id) WHERE (is_tournament AND (NOT (((((COALESCE(octet_length(jsonb_send(metadata)), 0))::bigint + (COALESCE(octet_length(jsonb_send(player_contributions)), 0))::bigint) + (COALESCE(octet_length(jsonb_send(returned_uncalled)), 0))::bigint) <= 448) AND ((((COALESCE(smarter_private.rake_record_jsonb_raw_size(metadata), 0))::bigint + (COALESCE(smarter_private.rake_record_jsonb_raw_size(player_contributions), 0))::bigint) + (COALESCE(smarter_private.rake_record_jsonb_raw_size(returned_uncalled), 0))::bigint) <= 1864) AND (((COALESCE(octet_length(source), 0))::bigint + (COALESCE(octet_length(rake_method), 0))::bigint) <= 128) AND ((((COALESCE(octet_length(numeric_send(rake_amount)), 0))::bigint + (COALESCE(octet_length(numeric_send(bbj_contribution)), 0))::bigint) + (COALESCE(octet_length(numeric_send(pot_size)), 0))::bigint) <= 128))))

name: rake_records_tournament_small_evidence_cover
definition: CREATE INDEX rake_records_tournament_small_evidence_cover ON public.rake_records USING btree (tournament_id, id) INCLUDE (hand_id, table_id, club_id, rake_amount, bbj_contribution, pot_size, num_players, created_at, player_contributions, global_hand_id, is_tournament, source, metadata, rake_method, returned_uncalled) WHERE (is_tournament AND (((((COALESCE(octet_length(jsonb_send(metadata)), 0))::bigint + (COALESCE(octet_length(jsonb_send(player_contributions)), 0))::bigint) + (COALESCE(octet_length(jsonb_send(returned_uncalled)), 0))::bigint) <= 448) AND ((((COALESCE(smarter_private.rake_record_jsonb_raw_size(metadata), 0))::bigint + (COALESCE(smarter_private.rake_record_jsonb_raw_size(player_contributions), 0))::bigint) + (COALESCE(smarter_private.rake_record_jsonb_raw_size(returned_uncalled), 0))::bigint) <= 1864) AND (((COALESCE(octet_length(source), 0))::bigint + (COALESCE(octet_length(rake_method), 0))::bigint) <= 128) AND ((((COALESCE(octet_length(numeric_send(rake_amount)), 0))::bigint + (COALESCE(octet_length(numeric_send(bbj_contribution)), 0))::bigint) + (COALESCE(octet_length(numeric_send(pot_size)), 0))::bigint) <= 128)))
